+def solve_routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << index for index, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full_mask = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])
+    distances = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])]
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, remaining = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, remaining)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full_mask:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], remaining)]
+            if remaining:
+                options.append((max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)), remaining - 1))
+            for duration, left in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                nxt = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(nxt, 0)
+                next_state = (nxt, next_mask, left)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, nxt, next_mask, left))
+    return {"arrival": None}
